ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.65 white to 0.35 black pixel ratio across the visible ventral surface, characterized by high macro-level contrast between the central white field and peripheral black margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central 70% of both lobes. Dark pixel saturation (black) forms a continuous border along the trailing and leading edges. A dense vertical dark corridor separates the two primary white patches at the peduncle junction. Significant black mottling is present along the inner-lower margins of the white areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 85-degree aperture and a pixel-depth roughly 5% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (1-5 pixel variations) along the distal 50% of both lobes. The serrations become more irregular and pronounced toward the outer tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a straight, slightly upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small cluster of dark pixel nodes on the lower-left white region near the peduncle connection. Scattered dark spots (speckling) visible on the inner-right lobe white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, dark diagonal linear mark (~40 pixel length) oriented at approximately 45 degrees on the central white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged contour at the distal tip of the right lobe, indicating potential minor tissue loss or structural wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Proninent dark vertical banding dividing the primary white pigmentation zones at the fluke center.
